package.name: tree_mapping_geometry
package.description:
ROS 2 (Jazzy) port of the geometry stage of the DREAMS-lab tree-mapping pipeline (Vishwanatha and Das, ASU). Provides:
* Cylinder fitting (Ceres-based nonlinear optimization) for tree trunks / branches given a per-segment point cloud. * Branch-instance segmentation from a Velodyne range image.
Vendored / ported from upstream: tree_mapping/src/cylinderFitting{,_BasePoint,_ResidualEval,_Data}.{cpp,h} tree_mapping/src/branchInstanceSegmentation{,_continuous}.cpp tree_mapping/src/main_RosAndFileHandler.{cpp,h} tree_mapping/src/main_UtilsAndParams.{cpp,h} tree_mapping/src/pcd_custom_types.h
